title: Playing GTA 6 For The FIRST Time!

clips.title: Mid Police Chase, He Orders Food
clips.hook: Guess what he does mid chase
clips.reason: Peak chaotic GTA humor: fleeing cops then casually hitting a drive-thru; tight, hilarious, instantly shareable, classic genre moment.

clips.title: Something Is Driving That Car
clips.reason: Absurd, funny visual gag that's very shareable, but the teaser repeats the exact punchline ('Scooby-Doo driving a car'), spoiling the reveal.

clips.title: GTA Robbery Goes Horribly Wrong
clips.hook: Why does she have a gun?
clips.reason: Chaotic stick-up scene with screaming and a brutal punchline ('should have shot his ass'); fast, funny, standalone action that fits the channel perfectly.

clips.title: The Illuminati Owns GTA 6
clips.hook: Why does fame get you on a yacht?
clips.reason: Hilarious conspiracy rant with great comedic delivery and a satisfying 'cold beer' punchline; slightly less visual/action-based but strong standalone humor.
